description: differenceLand: the sea/eraser brush subtracts from land. A cut that reaches both coasts severs the landmass into two components; a subtraction entirely inside the landmass leaves one component with a new hole (a lake). Written to complete the minimum fixture set in 04-geometry-pipeline.md, which lists S8 {cut, interior} but shipped no file.

assertions.note: The strip spans the full height, so the land is severed into two disjoint pieces.
A through-cut makes coastline, not a lake.
An interior subtraction never disconnects the landmass.
Water fully enclosed by land is a lake — a hole in the polygon (ADR-11).
